goal: Is ke baad aap basic types ke variables declare aur initialise kar sakein ge, valid names chun sakein ge, const use kar sakein ge, aur sizeof se sizes check kar sakein ge.
warmup: Canteen ke steel ke dabbay sochein. Ek dabbe par label 'Samosa' laga hai aur us mein 5 pieces hain. Doosre par label 'Price' hai aur us mein 30 rupay hain. Aap dabba khol sakte hain, andar dekh sakte hain, ya andar ki cheez badal sakte hain. Variable bilkul aisa hi hota hai: computer ki memory mein ek label wala dabba. Label us ka naam hai, aur jo aap andar rakhte hain woh value hai.
definition: Variable memory mein ek naam wali jagah hai jo value store karti hai, aur value badal sakti hai. Har variable ka ek data type hota hai, jo batata hai ke woh kis qisam ki value rakh sakta hai (whole number, decimal number, ek character, true ya false, ya text). Jo naam aap usay dete hain usay identifier kehte hain. Constant variable jaisa hota hai, lekin us ki value set karne ke baad kabhi change nahi ho sakti.
howItWorks: Play dabayein aur Visualize tab dekhein. Har variable ek label wale box ki tarah nazar aata hai jis mein us ka type aur value hoti hai. Variable declare karne se naya box ban jata hai. Assignment box mein value rakhta hai. Variable ko parhne se woh change nahi hota, lekin nayi assignment purani value ko badal deti hai. Yaad rakhein: variable use karne se pehle usay declare karna zaroori hai (type + name).
